title: The Book Opens
pages: You found the book in a corner of the shop, where the dust lay too thick to be accidental. The cover was warm. You opened it.
The pages spelled out an epic in a hand that seemed almost proud of itself - a hero's saga, told by the hero. You read about a dragon, a mountain, a vow.
You read until the lamp guttered out. You did not notice when the room around you fell away.
Now you stand in a small village under a sky that is not your own. The hero's saga has long since happened. He has gone. You are an extra in a story that was supposed to have ended.
